Select the option that best defines the given word.

Banish
solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"banish"** means to send someone away from a country or place as an official punishment; to get rid of something unwanted. (निर्वासित करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The king decided to banish the traitor from the kingdom.
 
 
 
• **"Relegate" **refers to consign or dismiss to an inferior rank or position; to move to a lower position. (पदावनति करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The team was relegated to the second division after a poor season.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the word **'banish' **is best defined by **'relegate'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To determine **(निर्धारित करना): To decide or conclude something after consideration.
 
 
• **Example:** The jury will determine the verdict by tomorrow.
 
 
 
• **To harm **(नुकसान पहुंचाना ): To cause physical injury or damage to someone or something.
 
 
• **Example: **The chemicals in the factory can harm the environment.
 
 
 
• **To evaluate** (मूल्यांकन करना): To assess or appraise the value, quality, or importance of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher will evaluate the students' projects next week.
